title: Recruit CRM integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About Recruit CRM
Recruit CRM is a powerful ATS and CRM platform built specifically for recruitment agencies and staffing firms. It helps teams manage jobs, candidates, clients and hiring workflows within a centralised system. With streamlined job management, pipeline tracking and client coordination, Recruit CRM enables agencies to improve placement speed and operational efficiency.
Why Integrate Recruit CRM with Xobin?
Integrating Recruit CRM with Xobin embeds AI-powered skill assessments directly into your hiring pipeline. With this integration you can:
Automatically send skill-based assessments when candidates move to a specific stage.
Track assessment progress without leaving Recruit CRM.
Sync scores and reports directly into candidate profiles.
Reduce manual follow-ups and administrative tasks.
Make objective, skill-based hiring decisions.
Xobin's AI evaluation engine, automated workflows and advanced analytics complement Recruit CRM's pipeline management, giving recruiters complete visibility into candidate capability before submission to clients.
Steps to Integrate Recruit CRM with Xobin
Generate an API key in Recruit CRM
Log in to your Recruit CRM account.
Navigate to
Admin Settings
Click
API
, enable the API token and copy the generated key.
Connect Recruit CRM in Xobin
Log in to your Xobin dashboard.
Go to
Settings > Integrations > Recruit CRM
Paste the copied API key and click
Connect Recruit CRM
Map jobs to assessments
Link Jobs to Assessments
Map Recruit CRM jobs to the relevant Xobin assessments.
Select the candidate status that triggers the assessment invite.
Choose the final status applied once results are synced.
Save your mapping configuration.
Invite candidates automatically
Open a mapped job in Recruit CRM.
Change the candidate's status to the configured trigger status and submit the change.
The assessment invite is sent to the candidate automatically.
View assessment results in Recruit CRM
Open the job and click
View Remarks
for the candidate.
View the assessment summary.
View Report
for the detailed Xobin report including performance analysis, score breakdown and evaluation insight.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruitment agencies, staffing firms, recruiters and talent acquisition teams using Recruit CRM. It is especially useful for agencies handling high candidate volume across multiple clients who want to automate screening, improve assessment accuracy and submit better-qualified shortlists faster.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
Status-triggered invites
Pick the candidate status that sends the assessment, and Recruit CRM fires the invite the moment a candidate reaches it.
Job to assessment mapping
Map each Recruit CRM job to the right Xobin test, including the final status applied once results sync back.
Results in candidate remarks
View Remarks shows the assessment summary on the candidate, with View Report opening the full Xobin analysis.
Agency-ready screening
Qualify candidates on demonstrated skill before submitting shortlists to clients, with no platform switching.
Client-ready evidence
Share objective skill reports alongside the shortlist so clients see why each candidate was submitted.
Configurable end status
Choose the status candidates land in once results sync, so your existing workflow stays intact.
